name: canon
description: Canon: enforce the canonical way. A lockstep-* series of framework-convention plugins (Astro, Vue, Nuxt UI, Tailwind, TypeScript, Echo, sqlc, Fastify, PostgreSQL) that lock Claude onto the latest official APIs, a flow plugin with manual work/commit commands, and plain-chinese for jargon-free Chinese output. Install only the framework plugins your project needs.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Manual workflow commands: /flow:go (work discipline) and /flow:cm (batched, spec-compliant commits).

plugins.name: lockstep-astro
plugins.description: Astro 7 static-first conventions; auto-activates on .astro files.

plugins.name: lockstep-vue
plugins.description: Vue 3.5+ single-file component conventions (script setup, Composition API); auto-activates on .vue files.

plugins.name: lockstep-nuxt-ui
plugins.description: Nuxt UI v4 component-first conventions; auto-activates on .vue files.

plugins.name: lockstep-tailwind
plugins.description: Tailwind CSS v4 utility-first conventions; auto-activates on .vue/.astro/.html/.tsx/.jsx/.css.

plugins.name: lockstep-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript 7 strict type-checking; auto-activates on .ts/.tsx and tsconfig.json.

plugins.name: lockstep-echo
plugins.description: Echo v5 handler and error-handling conventions for Go; auto-activates on .go files.

plugins.name: lockstep-sqlc
plugins.description: sqlc codegen conventions for Go + PostgreSQL; auto-activates on sqlc.yaml and query SQL.

plugins.name: lockstep-fastify
plugins.description: Fastify v5 plugin/route conventions for Node/TypeScript.

plugins.name: lockstep-postgres
plugins.description: PostgreSQL schema design + migration safety; auto-activates on migration/schema SQL.

plugins.name: plain-chinese
plugins.description: Output style forcing plain, jargon-free Simplified Chinese and stripping AI-tic phrasing.
